messages.message: hey my internet is barely working and i'm paying way too much for this plan!! 😡
Hello! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Ravi. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely help you with that today.
Before we dive in, could you please provide your account number for verification?
Thank you, Karan. I can see how frustrating it is when your connection isn't performing as expected, especially when you feel the cost is too high.
exactly!! and my phone is acting weird too, i think the sim card is dying 🙄
I'm sorry about that. Let's get you on a cheaper plan first. I can move you to the Basic Connect plan which is $35 per month, starting from your next billing cycle on October 1st.
that sounds way better. please do that. also can u fix the sim thing?
Of course. I will process the plan change now and send a confirmation SMS to 92359 89781 shortly. I'll also order a replacement SIM card to be sent to your home address immediately.
thanks ravi! you've been great. i just need to pay my current balance too, here is my card: four six one nine two three nine six nine three seven two nine three zero two
Payment received, thank you! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? To recap, I've lowered your plan and a new SIM is on its way. Have a wonderful day!
